categories.name: overview
categories.label: Overview
categories.headline: From idea to a complete ecommerce platform
paragraphs: Designed and built Caravano, a multi-tenant ecommerce platform for creating and managing fully branded online stores. The platform brings together storefronts, products, content, orders, payments, shipping, localisation, and administration in one system.

AI-assisted store and product composers let merchants describe what they want in natural language and turn those descriptions into structured, editable storefronts and product content. The generated result can then be reviewed and refined through the regular platform interfaces.

Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Payload CMS, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2, and Stripe, Caravano combines a flexible frontend with a full ecommerce backend, integrated services, and managed infrastructure.

categories.name: features
categories.label: Features
categories.headline: Commerce, content, and AI-assisted creation in one platform

items.title: AI Store Composer
items.description: A natural-language store composer turns a short description of a business into a structured starting point for the storefront, including content, styling, and store configuration.

items.title: AI Product Composer
items.description: Product information can be transformed into structured product content, helping merchants create listings faster while keeping the generated content editable and under their control.

items.title: Storefront & Branding
items.description: Flexible storefront configuration supports branding, typography, colours, layouts, content blocks, responsive experiences, and custom domains, allowing each store to have its own identity.

items.title: Products & Content
items.description: Products, variants, categories, pricing, media, pages, and content are managed through a unified administration interface with drafts and preview before publishing.

items.title: Commerce & Checkout
items.description: Cart, favourites, guest checkout, customer accounts, orders, discounts, and Stripe-powered payments provide the core shopping experience without relying on a collection of separate apps.

items.title: Payments & Operations
items.description: Stripe Connect provides merchant-specific payment accounts and direct payouts, while transactional email, order management, and shipping integrations support the operational side of running a store.

items.title: Internationalisation
items.description: Multi-language storefronts support English, Danish, German, and Spanish, with configurable currencies, VAT settings, shipping zones, and translation workflows built into the platform.

categories.name: technology
categories.label: Technology
categories.headline: A modern stack for a complex product
paragraphs: The platform is engineered around technologies chosen for maintainability, performance, flexibility, and a strong developer experience, while keeping the architecture practical for a growing SaaS product.
categories.closing: The architecture spans multi-tenant ecommerce, AI-assisted content generation, content management, payments, media storage, internationalisation, third-party integrations, and deployment infrastructure.

categories.name: product
categories.label: Product
categories.headline: Built to evolve with the product
paragraphs: Caravano separates the AI composition layer from the underlying commerce platform, keeping generated content editable and the core models independent from the way content is created.

This architecture makes the system easier to extend as new storefront capabilities, integrations, and AI workflows are introduced, without making generated content or predefined templates the centre of the platform.
categories.closing: From the AI composition layer to the storefront, administration interface, and underlying services, Caravano is built as one extensible product.
